title: Texas Hill Country Group Wine Tour by Limousine
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
Pickup and drop-off from designated meeting points
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum group size required for tour to run
policies: Minimum number of participants is 4 in order for the tour to run, if you have less than please contact tour provider.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: The Lux Drift wine tour is approximately 4-6 hrs from pick up to drop off. You will tour 3 great Driftwood/Dripping Springs wineries where you will enjoy different wines either by bottle service or if allowed a table side tasting, and stop for Lunch at Salt Lick BBQ, in one of our LUXurious Limousine style vehicles. ***It is important to note that this is a SHARED GROUP TOUR. (Parties of 2-4 may be completed in an SUV. Wine Tasting fees/bottles are NOT included in the tour price. **WE DO REQUIRE AT LEAST 4 GUESTS TO PROCEED WITH THE TOUR** SHOULD YOU CHOOSE TO BOOK ONLY 2, PLEASE BE AWARE THAT WE MAY CONTACT YOU TO SELECT A DIFFERENT DATE. M-F ARE NOT POPULAR TRAVEL DATES, BUT ARE GREAT FOR PRIVATE GROUPS. CONTACT THE PROVIDER FOR MORE DETAILS. Due to COVID19 we may change the schedule or itinerary based on state and local CDC guidance. For the protection of our team and yourselves we ask that a mask be worn while in close proximity with anyone not in your immediate group.
